title: Characterization Results on Generalized Smash Biproduct Hopf Algebras over the Partial Dual Construction
summary: Let $B$ and $D$ be both algebras and coalgebras in a braided monoidal category $\mathcal{C}$. In the literature, there are equivalent conditions for $(B,D)$ to form a generalized smash biproduct (or cross product) denoted by $B\times D$, which were mainly given by Bespalov and Drabant in 1999 as well as by Bulacu, Caenepeel and Torrecillas in 2013. This paper is devoted to constructing another biproduct $D\times B^\ast$ when $B$ has a left dual object $B^\ast$ in $\mathcal{C}$.
